notes: Commercial hosting provider Avanetco markets a Tajikistan VPS service from a data center it describes as located in Dushanbe. No public facility specifications, capacity, or independent verification were found; this is a small commercial hosting operation rather than a tiered colocation facility. Data Center Map and Baxtel list no commercial data centers in Tajikistan (per DCD, Oct 2025), so evidence is a provider marketing claim.
